newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: CRUDE PIPELINE TRANSPORT UP IN 1Q '97.
newsitem.headline: CRUDE PIPELINE TRANSPORT UP IN 1Q '97.

text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Wednesday that the total volume of crude oil and its products transported by pipelines was 5.18 million tonnes in the first quarter of 1997.
The statistics department said in a statement that this was an increase of 11.7 percent compared to the same period in 1996.
The statement also said that 856,500 tonnes of the crude oil transported in the first quarter was used for the country's domestic consumption, a 33.2 percent increase over the same period last year.
The rest, 4.325 million tonnes of crude oil and oil products, was moved through the country, an 8.3 percent increase compared to the same period in 1996.
